candidate_ladder.features: intercept plus frozen base-node log probabilities
candidate_ladder.identity_anchor: zero intercept and unit log-probability coefficient

fit_protocol.V2022: all D candidates equal their immediate base because no earlier forecast-target origin exists
fit_protocol.V2023: fit coefficients only on V2022 forecast-target pairs
fit_protocol.V2024: fit coefficients only on pooled V2022 and V2023 forecast-target pairs
fit_protocol.confirmation_refit: fit coefficients on V2022 through V2024 only after development method is frozen

shape_feature_contract.transform: context-centered log ratios of Dirichlet-shrunk shape probabilities
shape_feature_contract.missing_shape: all residual features and the applied increment are exactly zero

required_ablations: D2 versus D1 on identical rows

development_advance_rule.scope: authorizes only freezing a future confirmation package, never production
development_advance_rule.each_v2023_v2024_fold: candidate must improve both proper event scores in PA and player views versus the strongest simple outcome baseline
development_advance_rule.pooled_v2023_v2024: candidate must improve both proper event scores and wOBA/runs RMSE versus the strongest simple outcome baseline
development_advance_rule.calibration: no material supported-level reversal and calibration must improve versus C0
development_advance_rule.richer_ablation: D1 or D2 may advance over D0 only if both proper event scores improve on identical rows and wOBA RMSE does not worsen by more than 0.25 percent
development_advance_rule.simplicity_rule: choose the least complex candidate that clears every rule
development_advance_rule.failure: document and stop; do not tune fixed constants on the disclosed result

requirements_before_access: all coefficients and refit protocol frozen
eligible population and source hashes frozen
